item.title: Kidou Houshinki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Le.Chocolat
  • 発売日: 2006-05-12
  • スコア: 6.18/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 鬼道封神記
  • 英語名: Kidou Houshinki

あらすじ

Once upon a time…. A legendary country “Yama Taikoku” ruled by Himiko. The presence of this country is still remained in mystery and many historians argue about it. An archaeologist, Shuichiro, starts to show his extraordinary talent triggered by a certain incident. The basis of this power is called Kidou and this ability is only used by the descendants of Himiko. However, four women appear in front of Shuichiro. The battle between Shuichiro and four women breaks out….!

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Le.Chocolat
  • 発売日: 2004-04-02
  • スコア: 6.49/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: メイドさんしぃしー
  • 英語名: Maid-san She See

别名

  • メイドさん She See

あらすじ

Recently, Japan has seen the birth of various girls’ vocational schools for aspiring maids.

The story begins in the most prestigious of these institutes (which has an incredible success rate in the training of its students), where Hiroyuki Inagaki, an esteemed professor genuinally devoted to his profession, gets assigned 3 problematic maids-in-training.
